title: Scan any barcode. Launch its coin.
blurb: Scan any barcode, launch its coin, keep half its fees for life.

parts.note: Cover image — goes in the cover slot at the very top, not in the body.

parts.html:
Every product in your kitchen has a barcode. On Scanny, every barcode gets one coin.

Scan it first and it’s yours for life.

Scan it

Point your phone at anything. The fridge, the bathroom cabinet, the shelf at work. Scanny reads the barcode and pulls up the product’s photo, name and size.

Nobody launched it yet? You launch its coin on pump.fun, right there.

One barcode, one coin

The coin’s address is built from the barcode’s digits, so the chain refuses a second one. Whoever lands first owns that product for good.

Coca-Cola. Nutella. Heinz. First scan takes them.

Half the fees, for life

Every trade pays a creator fee. 50% of it goes to the first scanner, forever. pump.fun pays it straight to your wallet.

The split is locked into the coin at launch. Nobody can change it, us included. Scanny charges nothing to launch.

Go scan your fridge
